title: Private Equity Investor Portal Design, Development & Workflow
description:
Investor portal for private equity firms designed as a workflow-driven financial reporting system, centralizing portfolio data, investor communications, and document management into a unified operational flow.

The system uses Next.js as the interaction layer, Airtable as the structured data layer, and n8n as the orchestration engine coordinating reporting cycles, performance calculations, data synchronization, and automated investor communications.

This creates an automated reporting workflow that reduces manual coordination, improves data consistency, and ensures timely distribution of fund performance updates.

title: DealFlow - Internal CRM designed specifically for VC
description:
Custom deal flow CRM designed for venture capital firms, angel investors, and private equity teams, structured as a workflow-driven investment system for managing opportunities from sourcing and screening through due diligence to final investment decisions.

AThe platform is built around a structured data layer in Airtable, modeling startups, investment stages, founder interactions, and internal evaluations as interconnected entities that power downstream workflow execution.

n8n acts as the orchestration layer, automating stage transitions, triggering notifications, generating tasks, and coordinating reporting workflows as deals progress through the investment lifecycle.

The system replaces fragmented spreadsheets and generic project management tools with a unified deal management workflow that standardizes decision-making, improves visibility across the pipeline, and enables consistent execution across investment teams.

title: Live Global Market Pulse Dashboard Design & Development
description:
Real-time market intelligence system designed to monitor global market conditions across equities, cryptocurrencies, commodities, and foreign exchange markets through a unified, workflow-driven interface.

The platform integrates multiple external data sources including CoinGecko, Yahoo Finance, and ExchangeRate APIs, forming a multi-source data pipeline that aggregates pricing, market performance, and macroeconomic signals into a structured dataset.

Custom workflows process, normalize, and enrich incoming data streams before routing them into a unified reporting layer, enabling consistent cross-market analysis and reducing fragmentation across sources.

The system provides structured views of market sentiment, asset class performance, top movers, relative strength indicators, and economic calendar events, supporting faster interpretation of market dynamics and decision-making across asset classes.

title: Real Estate Investment Portfolio Dashboard Design & Development
description:
Portfolio management system designed for real estate investors to monitor property performance, portfolio allocation, occupancy metrics, rental income, and investment returns through a structured, workflow-driven reporting environment.

The platform aggregates data from multiple property and financial sources into a unified data layer, enabling consistent tracking of assets across locations and investment structures.

Automated workflows synchronize portfolio updates, calculate performance metrics, and generate consolidated reporting views, ensuring that portfolio data remains continuously up to date without manual reconciliation.

The system provides structured reporting interfaces for portfolio health, enabling faster analysis of performance trends and more informed investment decisions across diversified real estate holdings.

title: Investment Fund Portfolio Dashboard Design & Development
description:
Portfolio analytics system designed for wealth managers and investment firms to monitor performance, allocation, sector exposure, and portfolio composition across multiple markets through a structured, workflow-driven data environment.

The platform is built on a Next.js interface layer with Supabase as the underlying data infrastructure, integrating external financial data from Morningstar APIs alongside internal portfolio sources into a unified analytical model.

n8n-based workflow automations orchestrate data synchronization, metric calculations, and reporting updates, ensuring portfolio information remains continuously aligned across systems without manual intervention.

The system delivers structured analytical views including performance tracking, sector and geographic allocation analysis, and portfolio composition breakdowns, enabling consistent interpretation of investment data across advisors and stakeholders.

title: Bitcoin Intelligence Dashboard Design & Development
description:
Bitcoin intelligence dashboard designed to consolidate market, on-chain, derivatives, and sentiment data into a single research and monitoring platform.

The system integrates data from CoinDesk, CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, Coinglass, and Bitcoin Magazine Pro APIs. Automated workflows collect, process, and organize information from multiple sources to provide a consistent and up-to-date view of market conditions.

The dashboard enables investors, analysts, and researchers to track price action, funding rates, open interest, network activity, and broader market sentiment without switching between multiple tools and data providers.
